summary.text: Scott Gray is the incumbent Republican and Conservative Party candidate for New York State Assembly District 116 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A fourth-generation owner of Gray's Flower Shop in Watertown, he served 21 years on the Jefferson County Board of Legislators before his election to the Assembly in 2022.

paragraphs.text: Gray served as a Jefferson County legislator for 21 years in total, including six years as chairman of the Jefferson County Board of Legislators.
He has been a board member of local organizations including the United Way of NNY and the Carthage Area Hospital Board, and he received the Secretary of the Army's Public Service Commendation Medal.
Gray was elected to the Assembly on November 8, 2022, and represents parts of Jefferson and St. Lawrence counties.
He is a member of the Alcoholism and Drug Abuse, Energy, Health, Higher Education, and Tourism, Parks, Arts and Sports Development committees.

His official biography says he is the fourth-generation owner of Gray's Flower Shop in Watertown, where he lives, and lists agriculture, tourism, the connection with Fort Drum and public safety among his priorities.
